Software Engineer Dies After Falling From 30th Floor in Hyderabad

On a recent day, a 29‑year‑old software engineer from Suryapet district died by suicide after falling from the 30th floor of his rented flat at Golf Edge Apartments in Nanakramguda, Hyderabad; he had moved into the apartment only two days earlier, and a security guard discovered his body on the ground and alerted residents.
